sections.title: Zcash engine
sections.note: Built from the official Zcash core, librustzcash, and its dependencies, published under MIT OR Apache-2.0. The Zecky engine itself is MIT. Its Cargo.lock lists every crate.

sections.title: Fonts
sections.note: Inter and Newsreader, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
